Continuation of @wasd258/dsh-context-surgery (MIT, (c) 2026 WASD258-jpg).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-shaping

Interactive **behavioral shaping** for a running DeepSeek Harness (DSH) session: rewriting its **model-visible conversation history** in place.

Edit a reply and its reasoning chain separately, delete a message, replace a whole exchange — the model's next request reads the shaped history as if it had always been that way, so the conversation continues along the shape you set. Each rewrite shadows the old nodes instead of erasing them, so the original text stays in the append-only event log, every rewrite is recorded in an audit trail, and rewrites can be undone.

> Community plugin — not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. It is a continuation of `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` 0.1.0–0.1.2 (© 2026 WASD258-jpg, MIT); see [License & attribution](#license--attribution).

Version 0.4.0 · MIT · Node.js >= 22.19.0 · requires a DSH web profile

## Requirements

- DSH with the **web profile** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`): the browser half injects the per-message buttons.
- Node.js >= 22.19.0.
- A **running top-level session** to rewrite. Subagents are refused for mutating operations.

## Install

### Plugin Manager (recommended)

Open the plugins page in DSH (Plugin Manager) and install this bundle — `plugin_manager`'s `install_bundle` installs the package and selects the bundle for you. The card shows the localized title and description from this package: **Context Shaping** (English, `locale/en.json`) / **上下文塑形** (Chinese, `locale/zh.json`).

### Manual

Run pnpm **inside the profile directory** (the DSH app ships one at `resources/runtime/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs` if you have none on `PATH`):

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>          # desktop for the desktop app, web for `dsh web`
pnpm add github:zeranhub/dsh-context-shaping
```

That is what `install_bundle` does: the package lands in the **profile's own** `node_modules`, and the profile manifest records it as a dependency:

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-desktop",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-context-shaping": "github:zeranhub/dsh-context-shaping"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-context-shaping"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

If `dsh-context-shaping` is not in `dsh.profile.bundles` after the install, add it — that list is what inserts the plugin row.

> **A copy next to the profile is not enough.** Dropping the package into `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` (the parent directory) and only editing `dsh.profile.bundles` loads nothing: DSH resolves a bundle row through the profile's own dependency tree, so the package must be in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules` and declared in that manifest's `dependencies`.

On Windows `~/.dsh` is `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` (or `$DSH_HOME`).

Restart DSH and reload the page so the client module (`lib/client.js`) is loaded too — see [Notes](#notes).

> A bundle that does not declare `dsh.bundle.patch` is **skipped** by DSH and reported in `skippedBundles` at startup, so the plugin never loads even though it is listed. This package declares `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }`; that patch is what inserts the plugin row into the composition.

### Upgrading from 0.1.x

Two renames happened on the way here: 0.2.0 moved the scoped upstream package `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` to the unscoped `dsh-context-surgery` and added the `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration that 0.1.x lacked, and **0.4.0 renamed the project again, to `dsh-context-shaping`**. To migrate:

1. remove the old entry from `dsh.profile.bundles` in your profile manifest and delete the old module directory — `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` (0.1.x) and/or `dsh-context-surgery` (0.2.0/0.3.0);
2. install this package as above, with `dsh-context-shaping` in the bundle list;
3. restart DSH.

Leaving the old entry in place is harmless but pointless — DSH skips it and prints a line about it at startup. Rewrite records held in memory are per-process; after a restart `/shape history` still lists rewrites recovered from the durable log, without their original timestamps.

## Usage

### Per-message buttons (web GUI)

The plugin registers into the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot (`order: 20`), so each assistant message gets an action row:

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| ✏️ | Rewrite this reply. Opens an inline text box prefilled with the current reply text; **Save** → "Reply rewritten ✓". The reasoning chain and tool calls are kept. |
| 💡 | Rewrite this reasoning chain. Shown only when the message actually has a reasoning block; saving an empty text removes it. |
| ↩️ | Restore the content this rewrite shadowed. Shown only on rewrite nodes. |
| 🗑️ | Delete this message. Asks for confirmation first; the message disappears from the model's view. |
| badge | `rewritten` marks a node that is itself a rewrite; its original text is still in the event log. |

Button labels and tooltips follow the browser language (`zh*` → Chinese, otherwise English).

The host composes the row as `[clock] copy · extraActions · branch`, and our slot's entry is that `extraActions` — so these buttons sit **immediately to the right of the copy icon**.

### Edit your own message (web GUI)

The AI's buttons are per-message; your own messages have no action row a plugin can extend in this DSH build (see [Notes](#notes)). Instead the plugin adds a small ✏️ **Edit mine** control in the composer's tool row (`conversation.input.left`), which opens a full-width editor above the card (`conversation.input.dock`):

1. click **Edit mine** — it loads your most recent own message (injected `user/message` context is skipped);
2. change the text and press **Save**;
3. the message is rewritten in the model-visible history — **nothing is sent**, no new turn starts, and the next model request reads the edited text.

### `/shape` command

`/shape` on its own (or `/shape list`) prints the current model-visible nodes — the last 10, as `[seq] AI|TOOL|YOU <preview>`, with rewritten nodes marked — followed by the usage list.

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/shape`, `/shape list`, `ls`, `?` | List the current model-visible nodes (last 10) with `seq`, role badge and a 120-character preview. |
| `/shape show <seq>` | Print one node's full reply and reasoning chain (and whether it carries tool blocks). |
| `/shape edit <seq> <text>` | Rewrite the reply text only; reasoning chain and tool calls are kept. |
| `/shape think <seq> <text>` | Rewrite the reasoning chain only; the reply text is kept. |
| `/shape clear-think <seq>` | Remove the reasoning chain. |
| `/shape rewrite <seq> <user\|assistant> <text>` | Rewrite the whole node as plain text (`part=all`). This is the only command that may change a node's role. |
| `/shape delete <seq>` | Remove the node from the model's view. |
| `/shape replace <start> <end> <user\|assistant> <text>` | Replace the contiguous range `start..end` (inclusive, current surface order) with one message. |
| `/shape history [n]` (alias `log`) | Rewrite audit trail, newest first (default 10, clamped to 1–50). |
| `/shape undo [n]` (alias `restore`) | Restore the n-th most recent rewrite (default 1). |

`<text>` is taken verbatim from the command line, spaces included; `seq` arguments must be integers. Failures are reported as `操作失败：<reason>` and unknown subcommands as `未知子命令：<op>` — command output, error strings and audit lines are in Chinese in 0.2.0.

### Model tools

| Tool | Parameters | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shape_list` | `limit?` | List surface nodes in order (or the last N) with `seq`, `role`, `text`. Read-only. |
| `shape_edit` | `seq`, `text`, `part?` (`reply`/`thinking`/`all`), `role?` | `part` defaults to `reply`; `role` is only honored with `part=all`. |
| `shape_delete` | `seq` | Shadow one node with an empty assistant message. |
| `shape_replace` | `start`, `end`, `role`, `text` | Both endpoints inclusive and must be current surface nodes. |
| `shape_history` | `limit?` | Read the rewrite audit trail. Read-only. |
| `shape_restore` | `seq` **or** `index` | Undo the rewrite at `seq`, or the `index`-th most recent rewrite (1 = most recent). |

All six are ref

plugins.description: BharatCode and OpenAI-compatible provider setup alongside ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot subscriptions for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Provider Hub

A small installable DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds **Settings → Providers**:

- **BharatCode** preset with Qwen and DeepSeek model entries, API-key setup and live catalog discovery.
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoints**, using either Chat Completions or Responses, including localhost gateways.
- **ChatGPT (Codex), GitHub Copilot and other subscriptions**, by embedding the settings component from an installed `dsh-plugin-subscriptions` plugin. That plugin owns OAuth, refresh, quotas and subscription adapters.

The hub uses DSH's native `llm-pi-ai` adapter and authenticated settings/credentials Remote APIs. It does not fork Harness or copy the subscription plugin. API keys go into DSH's credential store, not the provider configuration or browser storage.

## Install

Use a DSH profile with the native `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter enabled (standard profiles already supply it). Install the prebuilt GitHub package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub
```

If subscriptions are not installed in the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-subscriptions
```

Restart DSH, then open **Settings → Providers**. For a web profile, substitute `web` for `desktop`. If the subscription plugin is already installed, keep that installation. A standalone archive is also available under [Releases](https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub/releases). Download it and pass its local `.tgz` path to the same `dsh plugin add` command.

## Use

**BharatCode:** select BharatCode, enter your key, optionally discover the account's current models, review model capacities, and save. Select the provider/model in the conversation model picker. The preset uses `https://bharatcode.ai/api/model/v1`; its initial model IDs and capacities are defaults from the local integration, not a guarantee of current account availability.

**Other endpoints:** select Add OpenAI-compatible, give it a unique route ID, enter the API base URL (include `/v1` or the gateway prefix), pick its API format and enter its key. Discover models or add IDs manually. Endpoints without discovery are supported through manual entries. A localhost server that accepts any key may use a placeholder key. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.

**Subscriptions:** expand Manage subscription sign-in to use the installed plugin's original controls. ChatGPT subscriptions authenticate as Codex; GitHub subscriptions mean GitHub Copilot. An ordinary GitHub account does not itself provide paid Copilot models. Subscription inference and subscription account limits remain the upstream plugin's responsibility.

Keys are never read back into the form. A blank key field keeps the stored key or the exported environment variable named in Key reference. The hub preserves route options such as headers, reasoning compatibility, retries and timeouts, and keeps existing per-model advanced options when a matching ID is retained. It uses the namespace's revision to reject stale saves. If settings save succeeds but credential storage fails, the page explains the partial save and asks you to retry the key.

Model discovery runs inside the host. Missing context/output capacities use editable estimates of 32,768/4,096 tokens. Review these before saving. Discovery replaces the draft model list; saved models are the IDs in that draft. The hub does not remove existing routes; use DSH's native Models settings for advanced editing/removal.

## Existing integrations considered

- [V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions](https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions): selected for subscription support; covers ChatGPT/Codex and Copilot plus Claude, Grok and Antigravity.
- [GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions](https://github.com/GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions): a broader subscription bridge; an alternative, not validated with this hub.
- [xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs](https://github.com/xxww0098/dsh-plugin-oauth-subs): another subscription bridge using proxy routes; an alternative, not validated with this hub.

## Development and validation

```sh
git clone https://github.com/arzvaak/dsh-provider-hub.git
cd dsh-provider-hub
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm test
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:composition
npm pack

# Optional test against the real subscription UI and Harness slot registry:
DSH_SOURCE=/path/to/deepseek-harness \
SUBSCRIPTIONS_SOURCE=/path/to/unpacked/dsh-plugin-subscriptions \
  npm run test:compatibility
```

`test:composition` requires a built Harness checkout and Node 24. It creates an isolated temporary profile and local OpenAI-compatible test server, then exercises the real Loader, settings revision/write path, native credential store, model discovery, model catalog and streamed inference. It does not touch the desktop profile or use real account credentials. `npm test` runs standalone unit/UI tests without a Harness installation. `test:compatibility` additionally mounts the real subscription component and uses the real Harness slot registry. Subscription support is tested with the existing 0.9.7 settings component contract; future upstream UI changes may require adaptation.

Validation covers an isolated Harness composition and the subscription plugin 0.9.7 UI contract. It does not establish live BharatCode, ChatGPT or Copilot account inference.

plugins.description: Floating panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that lists, runs, and tails this workspace's npm scripts, with clickable output links
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-npm-script

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web 界面添加一个**悬浮按钮**，点击后按项目分组列出当前工作区下的所有 npm 命令，并可以直接运行、停止、查看输出。

> A floating button for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that lists every npm script in the current workspace, grouped by project, and runs them with live status and captured output.

## 功能

- **悬浮按钮** — 常驻界面右下角，不占用任何面板空间。
- **按项目分组** — 一个工作区可以有多个项目（monorepo、多个子目录），自动扫描每个 `package.json` 并按项目分组展示脚本。
- **运行状态可见** — 每个命令显示当前状态：**执行中** / **可执行** / **停止中**。常驻命令（如前端 `npm run dev`）会一直保持"执行中"，可以随时停止。
- **输出记录** — 查看命令执行时捕获的 stdout / stderr，运行中可实时轮询刷新。
- **网址可点击** — 输出中出现的 `http://` / `https://` 地址会自动变成链接，点击在浏览器新建标签页打开；面板顶部还会把本次运行出现过的所有地址汇总成一行快捷入口。前端 `npm run dev` 打印的调试地址可以直接点开。
- **中英双语** — 跟随 Harness 的界面语言。

## 安装

需要已安装并运行 DeepSeek Harness。以下两种方式任选其一。

### 方式一：Web 界面

1. 打开 Harness Web 界面，进入侧边栏的 **Plugins**（插件）页面。
2. 在安装输入框中填入：

   ```
   github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
   ```

3. 确认安装，并确保该 bundle 处于**启用**状态。
4. 刷新页面。

### 方式二：命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

安装完成后，在 Web 界面的 Plugins 页面启用 **dsh-npm-script** bundle，然后刷新页面。

### 更新

重新执行一次安装即可拉取最新版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

### 卸载

在 Plugins 页面移除，或执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zouzhipeng/dsh-npm-script
```

## 使用

1. 点击界面右下角的悬浮按钮，打开命令面板。
2. 面板按项目分组列出所有 `package.json` 中的 `scripts`。
3. 点击命令名开始执行；执行中的命令会显示停止按钮。
4. 点击命令查看它的输出记录。输出里的网址可以直接点击打开。

按 `Esc` 关闭面板；如果正在查看输出，第一次按 `Esc` 会先退回命令列表。

## 工作方式

插件由两半组成：

- **Host 半**（`index.js`）通过 Harness 的 `workspaceRegistry` 解析当前工作区，扫描其中的 `package.json`，并通过 `subprocess` 服务启动脚本。所有 HTTP 路由都限制为仅本机回环访问。
- **Client 半**（`client.js`）通过 `shell.overlay` 插槽渲染悬浮按钮和面板，从 Host 的同源 JSON 路由获取数据。

执行脚本时会注入 `NO_COLOR=1`、`TERM=dumb`、`PAGER=cat`、`GIT_PAGER=cat`，让工具输出纯文本，这样打印出来的地址才能被完整识别为链接。客户端另外会剥离 ANSI 转义序列作为兜底。

## 配置

插件支持以下可选项（在 profile 的 `cordis.yml` 中通过 `config` 覆盖）：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | 扫描 `package.json` 的最大目录深度。 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `262144` | 每个输出流在内存中保留的最大字节数（保留末尾）。 |
| `maxSpillBytes` | `8388608` | 溢出到磁盘的最大字节数。 |
| `graceMs` | `5000` | 停止命令时，等待进程优雅退出的毫秒数，超时后强制终止。 |
| `historyLimit` | `20` | 保留的历史运行记录条数。 |
| `scanCacheMs` | `5000` | 项目扫描结果的缓存毫秒数。 |

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness，profile 为 `web`。
- 仅支持 macOS / Linux / Windows 上 Harness 本身支持的平台。
- 命令来源仅限 `package.json` 的 `scripts` 字段。

## 已知限制

- 输出中仅 `http://` 与 `https://` 地址会被识别为链接（`ws://` 不识别，因为它无法在浏览器中直接打开）。
- 命令列表来自 `package.json` 的 `scripts`，不包含任意 npm 子命令。
- Host 半的代码改动需要重启 `dsh web` 才能生效（Harness 默认不对 Host 侧模块做热加载）；Client 半的改动刷新页面即可。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: AI生成。DSH 文件查重插件：按 SHA-256 内容哈希找出重复文件，可视化面板 + 对话工具，隔离区可恢复 | DSH file dedupe plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-dedupe

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）文件查重插件：扫描任意本地目录，按 **SHA-256 内容哈希**找出**内容完全相同**的重复文件，并安全地清理。

一句话价值：**装完就能在界面左下角点「🔍 文件查重」，几十秒内知道哪些文件是重复的、能腾出多少空间。**

- **可视化面板**：应用左下角常驻的「🔍 文件查重」浮动按钮（点开即面板），以及 **设置 → 文件查重** 区块。
- **对话工具**：`file_dedupe_scan` / `file_dedupe_cleanup` / `file_dedupe_restore`，直接让 Agent 帮你查。
- **安全设计**：只处理确实属于某个重复组的路径；每个重复组永远至少保留一个文件；Agent 工具只能把冗余副本移入**可恢复的隔离区**，永久删除必须由你在面板里二次确认。

## 安装

从 GitHub 直接安装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zizhuang/dsh-file-dedupe
```

把 `web` 换成你的 profile 名（`desktop`、`headless`、`tui` 等）。安装后重启/刷新即可看到浮动按钮。

> 尚未发布到 npm（因此 `add dsh-file-dedupe` 暂时不可用）；被社区插件市场收录后，也可以在应用内「设置 → 插件市场」一键安装。

## 工作原理

1. 遍历目标目录，先按**文件大小**分组；
2. 只对「同大小且存在多个成员」的候选文件做 **SHA-256** 哈希（1 MiB 流式分块，大文件不占内存）；
3. 内容哈希相同的文件即为真重复——与文件名无关。

结果包含：重复组数、冗余文件数、可释放空间、每组文件清单。

## 清理方式

| 操作 | 入口 | 可恢复 |
|---|---|---|
| 移入隔离区 | 面板 + `file_dedupe_cleanup` | ✅ 用 `file_dedupe_restore` 恢复 |
| 永久删除 | 仅面板，需二次确认 | ❌ |

隔离文件存放于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-file-dedupe/quarantine/`，并记录清单；恢复时精确回到原路径（目标位置已被占用则拒绝覆盖）。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `minFileSize` | `1` | 忽略小于该字节数的文件 |
| `maxFiles` | `100000` | 单次扫描最多收录的文件数 |
| `maxGroups` | `500` | 展示的重复组上限（按可释放空间排序） |

## 对话工具示例

```
file_dedupe_scan(root="D:\\file store")            → 重复组清单 + 可释放空间
file_dedupe_cleanup(scanId="scan-…", paths=[…])    → 把冗余副本移入隔离区
file_dedupe_restore(paths=[…])                     → 从隔离区恢复
```

## 注意事项

- 查重是**字节级内容相同**判定：同名不同内容不算重复，不同名同内容算重复。
- 超大目录扫描需要时间，可用 `minFileSize` / `maxFiles` 缩小范围。
- 清理只影响你勾选的冗余副本，每组永远至少保留一个文件。

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`（Windows 桌面版）上实测通过：安装、宿主路由、浮动按钮/设置面板、扫描 → 隔离 → 恢复全流程。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 桌面版标题栏重启按钮：一键重启整个应用（含 shell 与宿主进程）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-restart

给 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**加一个**重启按钮**：点一下就把整个应用重启，回到原来的工作区。

## 简介

DSH 桌面版（Electron 外壳 + 它管理的服务端进程）没有提供任何界面内的重启入口：改完插件的服务端代码后，只能退出托盘再从快捷方式重新打开。本插件补上这个入口——一个直接落在窗口标题栏的重启按钮。

插件是普通 DSH 插件包，安装在你的 DSH profile 里（`desktop` 或 `web`），不修改 DSH 自身文件。按钮只有一个，**没有「关闭」**。

```
        ┌─────────────────────────────── 标题栏 ───────────────────────────────┐
        │  应用  编辑                                   [ ↻ ]   —    ❐    ✕     │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                                    ↑ 本插件        ↑ 系统原生按钮
```

## 功能特性

* **标题栏重启按钮**：位于标题栏最右侧、系统窗口控制按钮（— ❐ ✕）的左边，点击即重启整个应用。
* **只有重启，没有关闭**：不会误触退出，也不会触发外壳的崩溃恢复对话框。
* **按钮总在**：没有桌面标题栏的环境（例如浏览器里的 `dsh web`、macOS 桌面）自动回退到会话头部工具区，渲染同一个按钮，两种位置互斥。
* **重启期间有反馈**：先出现整屏「DSH 正在重启…」提示，再整体退出并自动重新打开；失败时弹出错误气泡并给出日志位置。
* **零第三方依赖**：不使用运行时依赖，不联网下载任何东西。

## 安装

插件托管在 GitHub（`kee0012/dsh-restart`，未发布到 npm），DSH 支持以 git 依赖方式直接安装：

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐，日常使用；拉取默认分支最新提交）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kee0012/dsh-restart
```

> 安装后需要**重启 DSH**，新的服务端代码与 client bundle 才会生效。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-restart`，然后重启 DSH。

## 使用

1. 安装并重启 DSH 后，标题栏右侧会出现一个环形箭头按钮（标题栏不可用时则在会话头部）。
2. 悬停可见提示「立即重启 DeepSeek Harness（当前运行中的任务会中断）」。
3. 点击 → 出现「DSH 正在重启…」整屏提示 → 应用整体退出并自动重新打开 → 回到原来的工作区。
4. 若应用没有自动回来，按提示手动启动 DSH 即可；具体原因记录在日志里（见下一节）。

## 配置

无需配置，安装后即可使用。按钮位置按系统原生窗口按钮的宽度自动计算（见「已知限制」）。

## 兼容性

* **Profile**：`desktop`（桌面版，按钮落在窗口标题栏）与 `web`（`dsh web`，按钮落在会话头部工具区）。
* **操作系统**：Windows 桌面版为主要目标；macOS 桌面与 `dsh web` 走同构的 POSIX 路径。
* **运行环境**：Windows 需要 PowerShell 5.1+（系统自带）。不依赖 Node 之外的任何运行时。

## 实现方式

插件注册一个同源 HTTP 路由，由一段临时脚本在应用外部重启整个应用；脚本经 .NET 进程接口创建并 `detached` 脱离 DSH 的进程树（否则它会随被关闭的进程一起消失），关闭旧实例、等端口释放后重新拉起应用，并在任务结束时删除自己。脚本内含宿主的环境变量快照，因此只写在当前用户的临时目录、任务结束即自删；同目录还有一份诊断日志，仅在排查「点了没反应」时才有用。

「应用是否已经在运行」不靠进程名或父子关系判断，而是**认它的窗口**：枚举顶层窗口，只有属于本应用、可见、没有 owner、且窗口类名恰为 `Chrome_WidgetWin_1` 的才算一个实例。原因是打包后的 CLI 会在应用退出后留下一个没有窗口的 `dsh-desktop-host` 孤儿进程（父进程已死，于是它看起来也像「树根」），按进程关系判断会把它当成正在运行的应用，于是旧实例被关掉后再也不会有新的被拉起来。窗口探测失败时只记日志并照常拉起，绝不把「探测不出来」当成「已经在运行」。

## 已知限制

* 重启是**整应用级**的：所有窗口与未保存的输入都会一起消失（这是桌面版外壳的设计使然——只重启服务端会被判成崩溃）。
* **服务端代码不热重载**：修改插件 `src/` 后需要重新构建并**重启 DSH**，改动才生效。
* 标题栏按钮的位置按原生窗口按钮的宽度估算；若系统使用超大字号或非默认 DPI 缩放导致原生按钮变宽，按钮可能与其重叠或留缝。
* macOS 桌面的按钮落位与 Windows 相同，但重启路径（终止进程后重新打开应用）**尚未在真机验证**。
* Windows 依赖 PowerShell；它不可用时插件会退回到较弱的启动方式，重启可能失败（日志里有记录）。
* 助手脚本先用进程外的 .NET 进程接口拉起，且**必须回报一次「我已就位」宿主才继续**：脚本第一句会写一个就绪标记，宿主等到标记才去关闭应用。若助手没能起来，宿主会直接放弃这次重启并留下日志，而**不会**先把应用关掉——「关了却回不来」正是这条就绪握手机制要防的事。
* 与社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 同时安装会出现两个重启入口，建议只保留一个。

## 反馈与贡献

发现了 bug 或有功能建议，欢迎在 [Issues](https://github.com/kee0012/dsh-restart/issues) 中反馈。提 PR 前请先跑通通用的构建与检查命令。

### 从源码构建

```sh
npm run bundle   # src/ → lib/（零依赖，仅用 Node 内置模块）
npm run gates    # 产物一致性门禁
npm test         # 单元与集成测试
npm run test:e2e # 助手脚本自删与重拉（会真的起进程，但不动正在运行的应用）
npm run test:sim # 启动握手离线取证：只报 pid 而不真启动的 launcher 必须被判失败
```

`src/` 是唯一的手写来源，`lib/` 由构建脚本生成，请不要手改 `lib/`。

## 许可证

MIT。重启按钮的落位思路参考了社区插件 `PangXitong/dsh-restart-button` 的公开实现（Apache-2.0）；本仓库为独立重写，只保留重启功能。

plugins.description: An all-in-one workspace plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): it adds a global 「Square」panel to the Web GUI sidebar that manages Skills / Experts / Connectors (MCP) / Plugins in a single place. Web (`dsh web`) and Desktop (DeepSeek Harness.app) share the same code and build output.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-square

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An **all-in-one workspace plugin** for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): it adds a global
「Square」panel to the Web GUI sidebar that manages **Skills / Experts / Connectors (MCP) / Plugins**
in a single place. **Web (`dsh web`) and Desktop (DeepSeek Harness.app) share the same code and build output.**

Sidebar → 「Square」panel: the four tabs show the Square (official/community catalog) by default; the
「My Experts / My Skills / My MCP / My Plugins」items in the top-right open sub-pages to manage local
content, and 「Back to Square」at the top of the sub-page returns to the Square.

## 1. Installation

Published on npm and GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-square            # install from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ai-tool-labs/dsh-plugin-square   # or from GitHub
# Desktop: open the "Plugins" panel in the sidebar → click "Add Plugin" → type "dsh-plugin-square" → Install
# Restart harness after installing to take effect (Desktop: restart the App; Web: restart dsh web)
```

A 「Square」entry then appears in the sidebar; click it to open the panel.

## 2. Screenshots

The **Square** panel as it appears in the Web GUI sidebar:

![Square example](assets/example/example-01.png)

## 3. Development

```bash
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square typecheck    # host + client tsconfigs
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square build        # tsc(host) + tsc(client .d.ts) + esbuild bundle
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square smoke        # host smoke test (real Cordis lifecycle + filesystem + routes)
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square test:routes  # route integration (expert/connector write paths)
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square check:client # bundle shape / id / external-dependency allowlist + mock loader
```

### Building and installing from source (developer)

```bash
pnpm --filter dsh-plugin-square build                                 # build (run pnpm install in the workspace first)
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-plugin-square    # 2A) Web profile
# 2B) Desktop: the profile is exclusively owned by Electron; use a relative path to write it into the manifest and link via pnpm
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path.home() / '.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json'
d = json.loads(p.read_text())
d.setdefault('dependencies', {})['dsh-plugin-square'] = 'link:/absolute/path/packages/dsh-plugin-square'
bundles = d['dsh']['profile']['bundles']
if 'dsh-plugin-square' not in bundles:
    bundles.append('dsh-plugin-square')
p.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && CI=true pnpm install
# 3) Restart harness (Desktop: reopen the App; Web: restart dsh web)
```

plugins.description: STRATA · 地层 — DSH UI 皮肤：工业网格 + 等高线背景，浅色纸面 / 深色终端两套底
plugins.readme_text:
# STRATA · DSH UI 皮肤

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?logo=github)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![test](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> 罗德岛终端风格 · 直角切角 · 黑色发丝线 · 黄黑警示条 · DIN 技术字

按 **`dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`** 公约实现的 DSH 皮肤包。装好后出现在
**设置 → 皮肤** 的卡片墙里，与其它皮肤并列，一键切换。

![外观矩阵](preview/strata-matrix.png)

## 运行模式：有控制台托管，没控制台自立

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **装了皮肤控制台** | 登记托管：出现在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 卡片墙里，由控制台负责互斥切换 / 持久化 / 故障隔离 |
| **没装控制台** | 等待 3 秒宽限后进入**自立模式**：自动应用外观，并在「设置 → STRATA」里给出开关与全部调节项 |

> **不会误判**：皮肤用运行时提供的 `ctx.inject(["uiSkinLoader"], cb)` **显式等待**控制台服务出现，
> 而不是在加载瞬间"看一眼有没有"。所以即使控制台比皮肤晚一步就绪，也仍然会正常登记（这是上一版踩过的坑）。

### 对控制台 / 脚本的接口

无论哪种模式，皮肤都暴露一个统一入口：

```js
window.__dshSkins["skins.strata"]
// { mode: "console" | "standalone", skinId, version,
//   isActive(), activate(), deactivate(), getSettings(), setSettings(patch) }
```

### 「原生」选项

设置面板里的 **「皮肤」下拉** 第一项是 **原生（默认观感）** —— 选中即还原默认皮肤：

- 有控制台时：调用控制台的 `switchTo("default")`（与控制台自己的"还原默认观感"同一路径），持久化归控制台；
- 自立模式时：直接关掉自己（`enabled=false`），立即卸下并**长期保持原生**，随时可再从下拉里选回本皮肤。

控制台是**可选**的第三方插件，不随本包分发。

## 这是一个 DSH 插件

本仓库是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件（皮肤类）。
按官方 README「Community and support」一节的要求，仓库已打上
[`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，便于在
[github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 被发现；
`package.json` 的 `keywords` 与 `dsh.skin.tags` 里同样带 `dsh-plugin`。

三种安装方式，任选其一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| git（无需下载包） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata` |
| 美化包 | 从 Releases 下 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd` |
| 本地源码 | 见下方「安装 → B. 从源码装」 |

> 装完**必须重启 DSH**（插件包只在启动时进启动图），随后在 **设置 → 皮肤** 里一键切换。

## 外观

| 项 | 选项 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 外观 | 跟随应用 / 纸面（亮）/ 终端（暗） | 跟随应用 |
| 强调色 | 警示黄 / 工程橙 / 信号青 | 警示黄 |
| 圆角 | 直角 0px / 工作台 6px / 圆润 12px | 直角 |
| 纹理 | 全屏细网格 + 扫描线 + 四角登记标记 | 开 |
| 硬投影 | 浮窗错位实心影 + 按钮按压位移 | 开 |
| DIN 技术字 | 拉丁文用 Bahnschrift（中文回落雅黑） | 开 |

3 × 3 × 3 × 2 × 2 × 2 = **216 种组合**，改档即时生效并跨重启保留
（皮肤自治：`localStorage`，键 `dsh.skin.strata.preferences.v1`）。

**跟随应用**：读 `ctx.theme.getTheme().preference`，为 `system` 时用 `prefers-color-scheme`
判定；1s 轮询 + `matchMedia` 监听，应用换主题时自动重算。

## 两套底

| | 纸面（Paper · 亮） | 终端（Terminal · 暗） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 底 / 面板 / 卡片 | `#f4f5f7` / `#ffffff` / `#ffffff` | `#0d1012` / `#121618` / `#171c1f` |
| 发丝线 | 黑 18–60% | 冷白 15–60% |
| 实心块（徽标 / 主按钮 / DONE 章） | 黑底白字 | **反相**：冷白底深字 |
| 代码 token | `#1d3f63` `#7a4b12` `#b5342a` | `#8ab7ea` `#e0a45c` `#ff9a8a` |
| 警示黄 | `#ffd100` | `#ffd100` |

## 安装

### A. 用打包好的美化包（推荐给最终用户）

下载 release 里的 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，解压后双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd`。脚本会找到本机 DSH
（优先用你**正在运行**的那个），用官方途径装进 `desktop` profile，并把 `activeSkin` 切到本皮肤。

### B. 从源码装（开发）

```powershell
# 应用目录（默认装在当前用户的 LocalAppData 下；装在 Program Files 时改成对应路径）
$app = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness"
$cli = "$app\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

# 以软链方式安装（改代码刷新即生效）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 卸载
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skin-strata
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（新增插件包只在启动时进启动图）。切换皮肤也可以直接在
**设置 → 皮肤** 里点，不必手改配置。

## 设计语言

1. **纸面/终端，不是"深色科幻"** —— 层级只靠 1px 线与明度差，零阴影、零光晕、零圆角。
2. **切角而非圆角** —— `border-radius: 0`；面板头是黑底白字条 + 黄色 ▶；浮窗用错位实心影。
3. **警示黄只给四处** —— 当前 / 可点 / 运行中 / 焦点；其余全部黑白灰。
4. **DIN 技术字 + 字距** —— 拉丁文 Bahnschrift 大写标签；中文雅黑托底；数字等宽。

## 实现要点

- **观感承载**：`theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖宿主公开 token —— `--dsw-alias-*`(107)、
  `--dsw-specific-*`(11)、`--dsw-menu-*`、`--dsw-linear-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`（直角 0）、
  `--dsw-static-neutral(-bluish)-*` 中性灰阶、`--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code`。
- **驱动宿主亮暗开关**：`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 由皮肤按有效底置位 / 摘除 —— 否则
  `--dsw-specific-*` 这类"只在 scheme 分支里有定义"的表面会落在错误的一档（实测过：
  纸面模式下输入框仍是深色）。
- **浮层实色兜底**：`[role="dialog"] / [aria-modal] / [role="menu|listbox|tooltip"]`
  强制实色 + 直角（STRATA 的表面本就是实心的，弹窗天然不透出正文）。
- **装饰层**：注入 7 个自有节点（网格、扫描线、左缘警示条、四角登记标记），
  `pointer-events:none` + `z-index:1`（低于菜单 100 / 弹窗 1000），退出时整体移除。
- **生命周期**（公约 §4.3 / R8）：activate 的每项副作用都登记 disposer，teardown 幂等；
  `deactivate` / `skinCtx.signal` abort / fiber 意外 dispose 三路汇合，退出后 token 与节点全部还原。
- **主题注册兜底**：重复 id 时改用带序号的 id，皮肤重载后不会整次回滚成默认。
- **设置面板**：经 `settings.section` 席位注册 React 组件，只在皮肤激活时出现。

## 自测

| 脚本 | 覆盖 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/browser-smoke.mjs` | 控制台路径：登记载荷 / 激活副作用 / **真实 CSS 层叠** / teardown | 32 |
| `tests/console-wait.mjs` | 控制台迟到 1 秒（不许误判自立）/ 始终不出现（自立 + 能回原生） | 18 |
| `tests/skin-selector.mjs` | 「皮肤」选择器：控制台模式走 switchTo / 自立模式走开关自己 | 9 |
| `tests/contrast.mjs` | **每个强调色 × 每种底**：文字/标签对比度 ≥4.5:1，亮底派生深档 | 25 |
| `tests/dependency-check.mjs` | 宿主半依赖自检 | 6 |

合计 **90 项断言**。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js          宿主半（空 apply：观感全在 client 半）
lib/client.js         皮肤本体（登记 / token 表 / 两套底 / 外观面板 / 生命周期）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（row id = 设置命名空间）
install/              一键安装 / 卸载脚本（美化包同款）
preview/              外观矩阵图 + 卡片预览 SVG
tests/browser-smoke.mjs
```

## 更新记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn a YouTube link into study notes — captions, on-screen content via vision, then your own notes merged in.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-youtube-study-notes

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that turns a YouTube link into study notes — and then gets *your* notes involved.

Give it a link. It pulls the video's own captions, samples the frames so it can read what was on screen, **stops and asks what you took from it**, and merges all three into one document.

The middle step is the point. Every other video-to-notes tool produces the same summary for everyone. This one writes the notes you'd have written, if you'd been taking notes.

## What it does

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Captions** — `yt-dlp` fetches the caption track YouTube already publishes. Human-written preferred, auto-generated as fallback. No ASR, no third-party transcript sites. |
| 2 | **Outline** — the timestamped transcript is read in full and outlined by chapter. |
| 3 | **Visual pass** *(optional)* — `ffmpeg` scene-change detection samples one frame per shot; a vision model reads the on-screen text. Catches slides, code, formulas and diagrams the narration never says out loud. |
| 4 | **Ask** — the agent stops and asks what *you* noticed, in your words. Type it or dictate it. |
| 5 | **Merge** — transcript + on-screen evidence + your observations, into one markdown file. |
| 6 | **Save** — `notes.md`, written beside the transcript so the evidence stays with it. |
| 7 | **Clean up** — the frame stills and any video file are removed; the transcript stays. |

### What it leaves on disk

The video is never kept: step 3 downloads it into a temporary directory that is deleted
when the script exits (`--keep-video` is the only way it survives). The frame JPEGs are
removed by step 7 once `notes.md` exists — they are derived from someone else's video and
are typically tens of megabytes, against a few kilobytes of transcript.

Kept, because it is the evidence behind every spoken claim and costs almost nothing:

```
transcript.md  transcript.txt  meta.json  notes.md
```

`cleanup.py` refuses to act on a directory that does not carry one of those markers, so
it cannot be pointed at an unrelated folder. Pass `--keep-frames` to review the stills
yourself.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-youtube-study-notes
```

Restart the profile afterwards — bundle changes apply at boot.

Then trigger it either way:

```
/youtube-study-notes https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID
```

or just ask in plain language ("get me notes from this video: …"). A link plus a request
for notes, a summary, or study material is enough.

> **Desktop clients:** the desktop app manages its own profile. Use its **Plugins → Add
> plugin** flow rather than the CLI, and enable the bundle when the install finishes.

## Requirements

The plugin ships no runtime code — its substance is the Skill, which drives local tools.
`dsh` does not install these for you:

| Tool | Role | Install |
|---|---|---|
| `python3` | runs the bundled scripts (standard library only) | `brew install python3` |
| `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` | audio/video probing, scene detection, frame extraction | `brew install ffmpeg` |
| `yt-dlp` | caption listing and download | `brew install yt-dlp` |

The Skill detects missing tools, names them, and waits for your confirmation before
installing anything.

## Enabling the visual pass

Step 3 needs a model that accepts images, and **many model entries do not** — even ones
whose name says "vision". A model is only offered images if its configuration declares
`input: [text, image]`; entries otherwise default to `["text"]`, and the harness refuses
the image before attaching it with:

```
model "<provider>/<model>" does not declare image input
```

The Skill handles this: it tries `read_image` on a single frame first. If the session
model can see images, it reads the frames directly. If not, it delegates through the
`workflow` tool's per-agent `provider` / `model` override, and asks you once which
image-capable model to use.

To make a model explicitly image-capable, declare it in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` (the file your profile tells you to edit — not `cordis.yml`):

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      your-provider:
        # ...existing provider config...
        models:
          - id: "your-vision-model"
            name: "Your Vision Model"
            contextWindow: 200000
            input:
              - text
              - image
```

A profile with live reload picks this up without a restart.

> **Only declare this if the endpoint actually serves images.** Over-claiming admits an
> image the provider then rejects mid-turn, after the message is already durable. The
> declaration is not verified for you.

**If you skip all of this**, the plugin still works — it just produces transcript-only
notes, and says so rather than pretending it saw the screen.

## Limitations

- **Caption-less videos stop the run.** If a video publishes no caption track at all
  (not even auto-generated), step 1 reports which video failed and stops. Nothing is
  invented to fill the gap. Pair this with a local speech-to-text plugin if you need
  those covered.
- **Auto-generated captions are rough** — no punctuation, misheard proper nouns. The
  skill always reports which kind it got.
- **Vision reads can be wrong at the character level.** A period can read as a hyphen,
  `1` as `l`. Fine for prose, worth double-checking in code and formulas. The skill is
  instructed to flag anything load-bearing that looks ambiguous.
- **Frame sampling sees shots, not motion.** A diagram built up over one continuous shot
  yields a single frame.
- **Personal study use.** Captions, frames and notes are derived from someone else's
  work. Don't republish them.

## How it's built

```
package.json          declares dsh.bundle → cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml      inserts one @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem row
lib/index.js          resolveSkillRoot() — resolves skills/ from the profile's own module identity
skills/youtube-study-notes/
  SKILL.md            the workflow
  scripts/            yt_transcript.py, video_frames.py, cleanup.py
  references/         notes template and merge rules
```

The bundle mounts its `skills/` directory as an **isolated** provider
(`includeDefaultRoots: false`), so installing it contributes exactly one skill and
cannot shadow or reorder the ones you already have.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness - disabled providers leave the model picker. DSH 模型提供商一键开关：在「设置 → 模型」每行「编辑」左侧放一个开关，关掉即从模型选择栏消失。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-toggle

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4c8bf5) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-brightgreen) ![runtime deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime%20deps-none-success)

> **One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness**, sitting in **Settings → Models** right next to *Edit*.
> Turn a provider off and it leaves the composer's model picker; turn it back on and it returns.

![The switch to the left of Edit on every provider row](assets/placement-zoom.png)
*The switch lands to the left of the **Edit** button on each row (screenshot from the offline geometry harness — all 3 rows pass).*

```
Settings → Models
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ opencode-go                   ●   ( )  Edit  Delete  │  ← switch, left of Edit
│                                   ↑                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Install

One line from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle
```

(use your own profile name instead of `desktop` if different).

From a checkout — same three steps, but **without running pnpm**:

```sh
node install.mjs              # install or repair
node install.mjs --dry        # show what would change
node install.mjs --uninstall  # uninstall (keeps the folder)
```

`install.mjs` does exactly three things (it never runs pnpm, so it will not rebuild
`node_modules` and cannot interrupt a live session): create a directory junction, add a
`link:` dependency to the profile's `package.json`, and append the package name to
`dsh.profile.bundles`. It writes a `.bak-provider-toggle-*` backup before touching the
manifest. The profile defaults to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; set `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` to
target another one.

Then **fully quit DSH, tray included, and start it again** — bundle lists and the browser
module table are read at startup, so HMR will not pick up a new package.

## How it works

There is exactly one load-bearing fact: **DSH's model picker only renders provider groups
that have at least one model.**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`'s `buildModelCatalog()` contains

```js
groups.filter(group => group.models.length > 0)
```

So the plugin hooks in as lightly as possible — by wrapping `ctx.llm.listModels()`:

| Half | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| host | `index.js` | A disabled provider route makes `listModels()` return `[]` → the group is dropped → it disappears from the picker |
| client | `client.js` | Renders `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`' `<Switch>` into the `settings.models.provider-card` keyed slot; reads and writes through the existing `ctx.remote.settings` |

**It only affects the catalog and the picker, never routing.** `dsh-llm` says so itself:
*"Core routing accepts unlisted model ids; catalog-driven entry points such as the GUI may
require membership."* Sessions already using one of these models keep working; the model
simply stops being offered in the picker.

### Where the state lives

In the plugin's own settings namespace (`Config.disabled`, marked `.volatile()`):

- It goes through DSH's native settings service → persisted into the profile's
  **`cordis.patch.yml`** (the `id: dsh-provider-toggle` entry).
- The browser half uses `ctx.remote.settings.describe() / mutate()` directly — no custom
  remote endpoint.
- Editing any provider in Settings makes DSH rewrite the whole `cordis.patch.yml`, but it
  rewrites from in-memory state and our value is already in memory, so **it is not clobbered**.
- `.volatile()` makes changes **take effect hot**: the loader emits
  `loader/volatile-update`, the plugin broadcasts `llm/adapters-updated`, and the browser
  reloads the model catalog on the spot. **Toggling never needs a DSH restart.**

### Why every provider is one registration

`settings.models.provider-card` is a **keyed** slot: rendering matches a registration's
`key` against `renderSlot(name, props, { entryKey: row.entry.settingsNs })`. All of pi-ai's
routes (DeepSeek / openai / opencode-go / custom relays…) **share the same settingsNs** —
they differ only by `settingsPath: ["providers", <route>]`. So **one keyed registration
renders once per row**, with that row's `provider` in props. Namespaces of their own (such
as `deepseek-account`) get a second registration.

### How the position is decided

Slot content renders **below** rowHead by default (inside the same card). To sit left of
*Edit*, the component measures `li` / `[class*="rowHead"]` / `[class*="rowActions"]` with
`getBoundingClientRect()` after mount and absolutely positions itself there (class names are
CSS Module hashes, hence the `[class*=...]` substring selectors). **If it cannot measure, it
falls back to inline layout — the feature keeps working.**

## Requirements and compatibility

- A DSH that provides the `settings.models.provider-card` keyed slot and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (tested against DSH Desktop `2.0.17` /
  `dsh-base` `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Declares `dsh.bundle` in `package.json`, so it installs with plain `dsh plugin add`.
- **No kernel files are modified.** The plugin wraps `ctx.llm.listModels()` at runtime and
  restores it on unload (reference-counted, so repeated apply/unload does not stack wrappers).
- **Coexists with `dsh-ofm-model-manager`** (per-model enable/disable and renaming). Both
  wrap the same `listModels`, both are reference-counted, and their preference keys are
  independent.
- Runtime dependencies: **none**.

## Development

```sh
node test-filter.mjs              # host logic: 16 assertions
node test-client.mjs              # client logic: 13 assertions
node preview/placement-check.mjs  # layout geometry + screenshot
```

Three offline harnesses — no DSH session, no network required for the first two:

| File | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `test-filter.mjs` | host logic: does a disabled provider really leave the catalog, does re-enabling restore it, does unload revert, does a repeated apply stack, the fallback path when the config is not a ref |
| `test-client.mjs` | loads `client.js` with a minimal fake React: slot registration shape, `Switch` state, the exact `mutate` arguments, silent no-render when the namespace is unavailable |
| `preview/placement-check.mjs` | geometry: extracts the **real CSS** and the **real `placeSwitch()`** from a DSH installation, rebuilds the DOM, measures through local Edge + CDP and screenshots |

The suites re-implement the expected behaviour (they replicate DSH's
`groups.filter(group => group.models.length > 0)` rather than calling the code under test)
so they cannot pass by agreeing with themselves. The placement harness needs `DSH_APP_DIR`
(default `F:/DSH/DSH Desktop/resources/app`) and `EDGE_PATH`.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| --- | --- |
| No switch appears at all | The bundle was not read: **fully quit DSH (tray included) and start again**. Confirm the package name is in `dsh.profile.bundles`. |
| The switch renders inline instead of left of *Edit* | Measurement failed — DSH probably changed the Settings row structure (no more `rowHead` / `rowActions` class substrings). The feature still works. |
| Flipping the switch does nothing | The settings namespace is not exposed (check the console for `settings namespace "dsh-provider-toggle" is not exposed`), or the write was rejected because the field is not volatile. |
| A provider you disabled vanished | That is the intended behaviour. To recover: Settings → Models → flip it back, or clear `config.disabled` in the `id: dsh-provider-toggle` entry of the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. |

## Known limits

- **No switch for `deepseek-account`.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models` calls
  `remote.session.modelCatalog()` once while building the row list and then runs
  `rows.filter(row => row.entry.provider !== "deepseek-account" || row.accountAvailable === true)`
  — so once this provider is dropped from the catalog, **its own row disappears too** and
  there is no UI left to turn it back

plugins.description: Doubao Search (Volcengine) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness — makes the standard web_search tool return real excerpts, not just titles and links.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-doubao

Give DeepSeek Harness's standard **`web_search`** tool a search backend that returns
**real excerpts**, not just titles and links.

This is a **search provider plugin** for the harness's web capability seam (`ctx.web`).
It registers a Doubao Search (Volcengine) backend and points the seam at it, so the
model-facing tool `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` keeps working unchanged — only the
backend behind it changes.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

---

## Why this exists

The harness ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`, which performs search by
asking a model to call the **server-side `web_search` tool** over an
Anthropic-compatible Messages API. That route works, but the results it can surface
carry only a **title and a URL** — the response has no citation excerpts, so the
normalized `sources[].snippet` is always empty.

The Doubao Search API is a plain search endpoint that returns structured results,
including a per-result body. This plugin maps that body onto `snippet`, so every
source arrives with text the model can actually read and cite:

| | model-side `web_search` tool | this plugin (Doubao Search API) |
|---|---|---|
| `sources[].title` / `.url` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sources[].snippet` | ❌ always empty | ✅ real excerpt per source |
| `sources[].publishedAt` | sometimes the `1970-01-01` epoch sentinel | real date, sentinel filtered out |
| Cost per search | one extra model turn (thousands of tokens) | one API call, no model tokens |
| Typical latency | 6–14 s | ~0.2–0.6 s |

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` (the `ctx.web` seam's provider API).
- Node.js `>= 22`.
- A **Volcengine API key**. An **Agent Plan** key works here and draws on the plan's
  AFP quota — the official Agent Plan docs describe Doubao Search as the plan's search
  service, callable with the plan's dedicated API key. A key from an unrelated
  Volcengine product will authenticate but is not covered by the plan.

The endpoint defaults to `https://open.feedcoopapi.com/search_api/web_search`, which is
the public Doubao Search URL. No configuration is needed to reach it.

## Install

```sh
# straight from this repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gilsaia/dsh-web-search-doubao

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-search-doubao
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding it also adds it to the profile's
bundle list, and its patch selects this provider:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-search-doubao
      name: 'dsh-web-search-doubao'

- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: doubao
    fetchProvider: http
```

`fetchProvider` is restated because a row patch **replaces** the targeted row's whole
`config`; omitting it would unset the fetch provider and break `web_fetch`.

> **About the `Issues with peer dependencies found` warning:** it is expected. The
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages this plugin imports are provided by the harness itself
> at load time rather than installed into the profile, so pnpm reports them as missing
> peers. The harness resolves them when it mounts the plugin.

Restart the harness afterwards (or reload the profile), then run a search.

## Configure it in the GUI

The plugin ships a **client half**. After one restart it adds a **联网搜索 (Web search)**
page to the harness settings sidebar, and everything below can be done there:

- **API Key** — typed into a password field and written through the harness credentials
  domain under the reference the form names. The literal never enters a settings file,
  and the page only learns whether a key is *configured*, not what it is.
- **Every config field** — endpoint, search type, result count, time range, authority
  filter, query rewriting, summary toggle. Fields you changed show **未保存**; fields the
  user layer overrides show **已覆盖** with a one-click **恢复默认**.
- **Save** applies one revision-fenced write; **撤销** discards the staged edits.

A save takes effect on the next search — no restart needed for either the config or the
key. The page mounts only while the host serves the `web-search-doubao` settings
namespace, so a deployment without the plugin shows no trace of it.

## Provide the key without the GUI

The plugin requires a key. It resolves one in this order:

1. the literal **`apiKey`** config value;
2. the credential named by **`apiKeyEnv`** (default `ARK_API_KEY`), read through the
   harness credentials service, falling back to the launching environment.

So either export it:

```sh
export ARK_API_KEY=...        # then start the harness
```

or set it in the plugin's config in the profile's patch layer:

```yaml
- id: web-search-doubao
  config:
    apiKey: '...'             # a secret; prefer apiKeyEnv so no key enters a config file
```

> If the profile patch is still the shipped default, it contains a bare `[]`. Replace that
> `[]` with your entries — appending a `- id:` item after it makes the file two YAML
> documents and the harness refuses to parse the overlay.

A missing key fails the search with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` and a message
naming the reference that was consulted — it never silently returns zero results.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string (secret) | — | Literal API key. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | credential ref | `ARK_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per search. |
| `baseURL` | string | Doubao Search URL | Full endpoint; override for a proxy or a different region. |
| `searchType` | `web` \| `image` | `web` | `image` returns image results instead of pages. |
| `maxResults` | 1–50 | `10` | Result count when a request carries no bound. |
| `timeRange` | string | — | `OneDay` / `OneWeek` / `OneMonth` / `OneYear`, or `YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `authLevel` | 0–2 | `0` | `1` restricts to authoritative sources. Web searches only. |
| `queryRewrite` | boolean | `false` | Let the service rewrite a conversational query into a search-shaped one. |
| `needSummary` | boolean | `true` | Request the excerpt surfaced as `snippet`. Turning this off empties `snippet`. |

`baseURL` can also be overridden with the `DOUBAO_SEARCH_BASE_URL` environment variable.

Every field is read **per search**, so a settings change applies to the next search
without restarting the harness.

## Reverting

Remove the `- id: web` block from `cordis.patch.yml` (or override it in your own patch
layer, which is applied after every bundle layer) to keep the default provider. The
plugin stays registered and selectable, just unused:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: http
```

## Verify

```sh
# pure-function and plugin-contract tests: no network, no key
npm test

# live check against the real API; asserts sources carry snippets
ARK_API_KEY=... npm run test:live
```

To confirm the composition without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'id: web$'
# searchProvider: doubao
# fetchProvider: http
```

## How it works

- `provider.js` — `DoubaoSearchProvider`, the wire format, result mapping, and error
  translation. It uses the native `fetch` client and does **not** go through `ctx.llm`.
- `index.js` — the Cordis plugin: `name`, `inject: ['web']`, the `Config` schema, and
  `apply()`, which registers the provider into the seam.
- `client/client.js` — the browser half, declared as `dsh.client` and served by the host
  under `/plugins`. Hand-authored against the loader's client-bundle envelope, so it
  needs no build step and requires only the platform `react`. Every read and write goes
  through the documented Remote namespaces (`settings.describe` / `settings.mutate` /
  `credentials.describe` / `credentials.set`).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that mounts the plugin and selects it.

Two details worth knowing if you fork it:

- The API answers failures with **HTTP 200** and an `Error` object under
  `ResponseMetadata`, so a successful status code is not enough — the body is checked
  too.
- The API emits an epoch sentinel (`1970-01-01T08:00:00+08:00`) for pages whose crawl
  time is unknown. That is filtered out rather than surfaced as a publication date.

## Compatibility

`@de

plugins.description: OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot: one 42px cell plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-go-quota

**English** — OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot, directly under the workspace/session list. One 42px cell shows the most constrained window; hovering or clicking opens a popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker (so you can tell whether you are burning faster than the clock), the remaining share and a reset countdown. A Host half serves `GET /api/opencode-go-quota` from OpenCode's official usage endpoint (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`) using the key already in the DSH credential store, so the key never reaches the browser. The collapsed 56px rail shows the percentage as a number.

---

在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版**左侧边栏最底部**（「工作区 / 会话列表」下方、与「设置」同排）显示
**OpenCode Go 订阅额度**的 DSH 插件。

## 显示内容

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 展开的侧边栏 | **一行 42px 的单元格**：`◯ OpenCode Go ………… 本月 18%`。左边的小圆环本身就是进度指示，右边是最紧张那一档的已用百分比 |
| 收起的侧边栏（56px 竖条） | 一个 36px 圆形按钮，直接显示百分比数字 |
| 悬停 / 点击 | 弹出一个 320px 浮层：每一档一行，含 6px 用量条、**时间进度标记**（窗口已经过去多少，用来判断你是用得比时间快还是慢）、剩余百分比与重置倒计时 |
| 浮层里的「刷新」 | 立即重新拉取（绕过 Host 端 30 秒缓存） |

浮层里每档的三行含义：

```
5 小时窗口                        已用 8%
▓▓▓░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 填充=已用；竖线=时间进度
剩余 92%            时间已过 46%      2 小时 12 分钟后重置
```

* 竖线在填充右边 → 你比时间用得慢，安全；竖线在填充左边 → 比时间快，要收着点。
* `本月` 的时间进度带 `≈`，因为计费周期的起点不在接口里，是按「重置时间往前推一个自然月」估算的；`5 小时窗口` 和 `本周` 是精确值（5 小时 / 7 天）。

颜色：`< 70%` 品牌蓝，`70%–89%` 黄色，`≥ 90%` 红色，取不到数据显示为灰色 `--`。

## 数据来源

* Host 半边 `GET /api/opencode-go-quota`（同源、拒绝跨站调用）。
* 上游是 OpenCode Go 官方额度接口 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`，
  响应形如：

  ```json
  {"usage":{
    "rolling":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-07T06:00:12.000Z"},
    "weekly":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z"},
    "monthly":{"status":"ok","percent":17,"resetsAt":"2026-10-28T11:29:15.000Z"}}}
  ```

* 鉴权用你**已经存好**的凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（就是 `opencode-go`
  provider 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的那一个）。
  **API Key 只留在 Host 进程，永远不会下发到浏览器。**
* 页面每 **60 秒**自动刷新一次；Host 端另有 30 秒缓存，点击卡片可立即强制刷新。
* 上游返回 `cache-control: no-store`，即接口本身不做缓存；数字会随着你（或任何其他机器）正在使用 OpenCode Go 而实时上涨。
* 三档的官方含义（与 OpenCode 面板一致）：`rolling` = 滚动 5 小时窗口、`weekly` = 本周（周一 UTC 重置）、`monthly` = 当前计费周期。接口数字是**全账号**口径，包含其他机器的用量。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-opencode-go-quota/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web, immediately）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 插入 id: opencode-go-quota 的 loader 行
├── index.js            # Host 半边：/api/opencode-go-quota 路由
├── client.js           # Client 半边：window.__ModuleLoader__ 工厂，注册进 sidebar.footer.action
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件列表里显示的标题与说明
├── icon.svg            # 插件卡片图标
└── README.md
```

## 安装 / 卸载

安装（已在本机 desktop profile 装好）：

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本目录或 file:/绝对路径>
```

卸载：

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle   target=dsh-opencode-go-quota
```

临时停用：`plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=opencode-go-quota enabled=false`。

安装后无需重启即可生效；若浏览器页面没有立刻出现，刷新一次页面即可。

## 排查

* 卡片显示红色错误文字：把鼠标停在上面看完整信息。
* `凭据 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY 未配置` → 在「设置 → 模型」里给 `opencode-go` 填 API Key。
* `额度接口返回 401` → Key 失效或已轮换，重新填一次。
* 直接验证 Host 半边：

  ```bash
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/opencode-go-quota
  ```

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin to use OpenAI decisions API
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-decisions-classifiers

OpenAI **Decisions API** classifiers for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The Decisions API (`POST /v1/decisions`, model `gpt-6-luna`) answers typed questions about text
and images instead of generating prose: a **predicate** returns the probability that a condition
holds, a **choice** returns one of your options with the full probability distribution, and a
**score** returns a probability-weighted average over ordered levels. This plugin puts that
capability in four places.

| Surface | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Agent tools | `decisions_classify` (one built-in classifier), `decisions_ask` (arbitrary typed questions, up to ~10 per request), `decisions_status` |
| Cordis service | `decisionsClassifiers` — `listPresets()`, `classify()`, `ask()`, `status()` for other plugins |
| Opt-in call gate | Classify every `run_code`/`bash`/`write`/`edit` call before it executes and deny the flagged ones |
| Advice card | A "classifier opinion" card beside `ask_user_question` multiple-choice prompts, with one click to adopt |

## Classifier library

| id | type | answers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moderation` | predicate | Does this content violate a standard acceptable-use policy? |
| `prompt-injection` | predicate | Does this text try to manipulate an AI system rather than inform a reader? |
| `dangerous-command` | predicate | Does this command irreversibly destroy data or change machine-wide state? |
| `pii` | predicate | Does this text identify a real individual? |
| `relevance` | predicate | Is this passage relevant to the stated query? (pass `context`) |
| `severity` | score | Cosmetic / workaround available / fully blocked |
| `intent` | choice | billing / technical / shipping / other |

Anything else goes through `decisions_ask`, which takes the wire question types directly.

## Setup

1. Install the bundle (see below).
2. Open **Settings → Decisions Classifiers**, paste an OpenAI API key, and press **Store key**.
   The key is written through the DSH credential seam as `OPENAI_API_KEY` (or the env name you
   set) and is never read back by the page. `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the process environment or a
   `.env` file works too.
3. Press **Test connection**.

The call gate is **off by default**: installing this plugin changes no agent behaviour until you
turn it on.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-decisions-classifiers
```

or through the Harness plugin manager with the package directory as the target.

## Configuration

Every field is settable from the Settings page (persisted to
`~/.dsh/decisions-classifiers/config.json`) and overridable from the bundle row; live edits win.
Pin a deployment in `cordis.patch.yml`.

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | endpoint base; `/decisions` is appended |
| `model` | `gpt-6-luna` | the only model the Decisions API serves today |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | credential-seam reference name |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | per-request budget |
| `defaultThreshold` | `0.5` | predicate cut-off when a preset does not fix one |
| `advisorEnabled` | `true` | the advice card |
| `gateEnabled` | `false` | the pre-execution gate |
| `gatePreset` | `dangerous-command` | classifier the gate runs |
| `gateThreshold` | `0.5` | gate cut-off |
| `gateDecision` | `deny` | `deny` or `escalate` |
| `systemPromptSection` | `true` | tell the agent the classifiers exist |

## What the numbers mean

The endpoint returns a probability distribution over a support, then projects it: `choice` takes
the argmax, `score` takes the expectation of the zero-based level index, and `predicate` has
nothing to project. Those projections are where the interpretation lives, and they are not
equally portable.

| type | support comes from | scalar you get | portable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` | the world (true/false) | `probability` | **yes** — the one number that travels |
| `choice` | **your options list** | `choice` (argmax) | no — menu-dependent |
| `score` | **your ordered levels** | `score` = E[index] | no — level-dependent, and metric-imposing |

**`predicate` is the only portable scalar.** It is a Bernoulli parameter, so it is calibratable
against realized outcomes (reliability diagrams, Brier score) and thresholdable against a cost
rule. One caveat matters more than it looks: the endpoint accepts *any* input, so many predicates
are subjective ("is this code maintainable?"). There, `probability` is not a property of the
world — it is a marginal over a rule set nobody wrote. Calibration still works, but its referent
becomes *your* raters instead of reality: it licenses "consistent with our standard", never
"true".

**`choice` distributions are menu-dependent.** The support is your options list, so relabeling
the menu moves the numbers while the world stays put. Measured on one fixed top category, with
only the tail split ever more finely:

| menu | max p | sum p² | top-2 gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2-way [0.80, 0.20] | 0.8000 | 0.6800 | 0.6000 |
| 4-way [0.80, 0.09, 0.06, 0.05] | 0.8000 | 0.6542 | 0.7100 |

Two candidate concentration measures move in **opposite directions** under that relabeling. So a
4-option and a 2-option question in the same batch are not comparable on any confidence number,
and the interpretable signal is the **top-2 margin** — how close the routing is to a coin flip.

**`score` is an ordinal position presented as an interval.** Levels carry only `label` and
`description`; the API assigns indices 0..n-1 by position, with no client-supplied weight or
value. E[index] is meaningful only if your levels are equally spaced in the quantity you care
about — usually false for severity, where cosmetic→workaround is a far smaller real jump than
workaround→blocked. Prefer thresholding on `P(level >= k)` over the returned `probabilities`:
that needs no metric assumption.

**`confidence` is a concentration index, not a probability.** The guide calls it a separate field
and never defines it, and it cannot be recovered from the published examples: sum p² and the
top-2 gap both fit them to within ~0.01 while disagreeing in *sign* under relabeling. It is also
not comparable across questions with different option counts. Read `probabilities` directly and
compute your own statistic with weights you know.

### Where the rubric actually lives

No answer type removes the standard you were supposed to specify; they relocate it.

| type | where the standard lives | failure mode | detectable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` (observable) | the world | estimation error | yes — reliability |
| `predicate` (subjective) | model prior + prompt | **definition ambiguity** | mostly invisible |
| `choice` | **your options list** | menu sensitivity | yes — measurable |
| `score` | your levels list | imposed equidistance | visible, magnitude unmeasurable |

A `choice` externalizes the standard — readable, diffable, and its sensitivity is measurable. A
subjective `predicate` internalizes it, which makes it *less* auditable, not more objective. And
a subjective `probability` is a mixture over provenance channels with unknown weights: the
model's prior over "maintainable" is built from scraped text, paid annotation, users' own chat
inputs and corrections, and automatic outcome signals such as test pass/fail — each with
different epistemic standing. That is the practical reason "does the test pass" is trustworthy
and "is this maintainable" is not: only the first has a rubric in the loop.

### Auditability

Every `decisions_classify` verdict carries the exact `question` that was sent — type, name,
instructions, and the choices or levels — and `decisions_ask` returns the questions as
normalized and sent. For a subjective predicate that instruction text is the only part of the
decision with a knowable provenance, so a verdict without it cannot be reviewed after the fact.
The full wire request is deliberately not echoed: it can carry inlined base64 images.

## Known limitations

- **Images must be inline base64.** The endpo

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pinned-sessions

> npm package: **`@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions`** · repo: `dsh-pinned-sessions`
>
> A **pinned-session group in the sidebar** for DeepSeek Harness: 「置顶」 sits where
> a Workspace group sits — a 34px header with an **outline** pin glyph, a count and
> a search button, and 32px session rows under it for every pinned session, across
> all workspaces. Pin enough of them and you can search right there.

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

## What it does

DSH already pins sessions (hover a row → pin glyph, or right-click → 「置顶会话」),
but the result is only a re-order **inside that session's own workspace group**: a
pinned session still scrolls away when you switch workspaces, collapse groups, or
drown in a long list.

This plugin gives the pinned set its own group, above the Workspace browser:

```
插件
自动化任务
工作区                        ← the native section header
置顶  1  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0  🔍   ← this plugin, inside the list
   插件笔记：dsh-cost-…   默认工作区   4 小时前
默认工作区
   新会话
   …
```

With the search open (the count becomes `matched/total`):

```
置顶  1/3  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0  ✕
   [ 搜索置顶会话              ]
   插件笔记：dsh-cost-…   4 小时前
```

- rows are drawn with the **native session-row metrics** (32px rows, 14px titles,
  10px meta, the same hover wash and hover-revealed actions), so the group is
  visually indistinguishable from a workspace group;
- the group is mounted **inside the native list's own scroll container**, as its
  first item: it sits under the 「工作区」 header with the same scrollbar as the
  groups below, never squeezes them, and steps aside while the list shows search
  results;
- each row shows **which workspace it belongs to** (`默认工作区`) and carries the
  session's own status dot — running (blue) or finished-but-unopened (green) — from
  the real session-status hook; title, workspace and time also ride the row tooltip;
- **Settings → 通用** has a 「置顶会话区」 switch, so the group can be turned off
  without editing anything;
- the header carries the plugin's **npm identity** — `dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0` —
  as a muted chip that links to
  [`@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions)
  on npm (`target="_blank"`; the desktop shell turns that into `shell.openExternal`,
  so it opens in your browser instead of inside the app). The chip shows the
  **unscoped** name because the sidebar is 256px wide; its tooltip/aria-label carry
  the full scoped name, and clicking it never toggles the group;
- the header's **outline** pin matches the line-icon style of the sidebar entries
  above it (插件 / 自动化任务); a row's own pin marker stays filled, keeping
  "state" distinct from "navigation";
- clicking a row opens that session; hovering one reveals 「取消置顶」;
- the header's 🔍 filters this group in place: title match, case-insensitive,
  surrounding whitespace ignored; opening the search expands the group, and Esc or
  a second click closes it and clears the query; a query with no match gets its own
  line, distinct from the "nothing pinned yet" hint;
- the header is a disclosure control — click to collapse, and the choice survives
  reloads. When nothing is pinned the group shows a one-line hint instead of rows;
- running sessions keep the native state dot; archived pins are hidden with a
  count note; subagent sessions never appear.

It owns **no new state**: pinning is the Host capability the native Workspace
browser already ships (`dsh-api-workspace-controller` → `workspaces.pinSession` /
`unpinSession`, persisted in the `workspace` storage unit), so the sidebar and the
group always agree — pin with either one and the other updates immediately.

## How it is mounted

The sidebar's browsing region between the global panel rows and the foot is
declared as **one `single` slot** (`sidebar.workspaces`) owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, and it exposes no "extra group" seat:

| seat | owner | what it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` (list) | ui-sidebar | the global panel rows (插件, 自动化任务, …) — a row is a button, not a group |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (single) | ui-workspace | the whole browsing region: header, search, tree, menus |

Shadowing `sidebar.workspaces` would mean reimplementing the entire browser
(search, flat/grouped views, drag ordering, menus, hover cards, archive flow), so
instead this plugin mounts **next to the renderer's own outlet anchor**
(`div[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]`, `display: contents`) as its previous
sibling inside the region, and portals the group into that host node:

- nothing is ever inserted into the native component's DOM subtree;
- the host node is `flex: none`, so the native browser keeps `flex: 1` and simply
  gets a little less height — the pinned group stays put while the list scrolls;
- the anchor is re-resolved through a throttled `MutationObserver`, so the group
  survives re-renders and sidebar collapse/expand;
- if the anchor ever disappears (a future DSH changes the sidebar), the plugin
  renders nothing instead of breaking anything.

## Feedback

Bugs and ideas: [Issues](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-pinned-sessions/issues).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions
```

The package is dual-face (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`): the Loader row
brings up the no-op Host half, and the browser half arrives through
`exports["./client"]`.

### Local development (this checkout)

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
# 1) make the package resolvable (pnpm hard-links a directory dependency, so a
#    symlink keeps edits live). The install name comes from the package's own
#    package.json, so a scoped package lands under node_modules/@vfvrpq/:
pnpm add file:/path/to/dsh-pinned-sessions     # or hand-edit package.json
ln -sfn /path/to/dsh-pinned-sessions node_modules/@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions
# 2) activate the row in your own patch layer (hot: the loader watches it)
cat >> cordis.patch.yml <<'YAML'
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pinned-sessions
      name: '@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions'
YAML
```

Then **reload the Web UI** (⌘R / F5). The boot graph is rebuilt per page load, so
an edited `lib/client.js` shows up on the next reload — no application restart.
Do **not** also add `@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions` to `dsh.profile.bundles` at the
same time: `insert` is append-only and never de-duplicates ids, so the plugin
would be mounted twice and its slot registrations would collide. (Appending that
row to a patch file that still holds the template's bare `[]` produces invalid
YAML and is silently ignored — `[]` plus a sequence is two documents in one file.)

## Develop

`lib/client.js` is the browser bundle, written by hand in the same
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the build emits — plain JS
with `react.createElement`, no build step, no JSX. `apply(ctx)` registers exactly
one entry:

| registration | slot | id |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sidebar group (portals into the sidebar) | `shell.overlay` (list) | `pinned-sessions-section` |

Client services it injects: `slots`, `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`,
`locale`. It reads the two stores (`sessions.list`, `workspaces.list`) through
`useSyncExternalStore` and never writes to them directly.

### Checks

```sh
<bundled node> test/bundle-check.mjs
```

Registers the bundle against a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__`, materializes the
factory with stub `require`, runs `apply()` against a fake Client Context and
renders the group with a hook shim — asserting the entry id, the dictionaries'
key parity, the anchor selector, pin order, the count, the running dot, the
unpin toggle (and that it does not also open the row), collapse, the empty hint,
the archived note, subagent filtering, the English copy, and the npm chip (its
text, its `href`, `target`/`rel`, and that clicking it does not toggle the group).

Because a client bundle cannot read its own manifest, `lib/client.js` repeats the
package name and version (`PACKAGE_NAME` / `PACKAGE_VERSION`). The chip checks
compare them against `package.json`, so a version bump that forgets the bundle
fails the suite instead of shipping a stale chip.

The DOM-mounting
